stories.title: As Chinese carmakers diversify beyond CATL batteries, Beijing warns of market overreaction

en.title: As Chinese carmakers diversify beyond CATL batteries, Beijing warns of market overreaction
en.summary: China's industry ministry has cautioned against market concerns about "de-CATLisation" as automakers expand their battery suppliers. The ministry stated that supplier diversification and in-house battery projects are normal business practices.

stories.title: 中国队获亚运会男女4X100米混合泳接力冠军

en.title: Chinese team wins Asian Games men's and women's 4x100m mixed medley relay championship
en.summary: China's mixed relay team of Xu Jiayú, Dong Zhihao, Zhang Yufei, and Yu Yiting won the Asian Games swimming event in 3 minutes 40.38 seconds, successfully defending their title.

stories.title: 亚运会女子400米个人混合泳：于子迪夺冠、柯雯曦摘银

en.title: Asian Games women's 400m individual medley: Yu Zidi wins gold, Ke Wenxi takes silver
en.summary: Thirteen-year-old Chinese swimmer Yu Zidi won the Asian Games women's 400m individual medley final with a time of 4 minutes 32.56 seconds, setting a games record. Fifteen-year-old teammate Ke Wenxi earned silver.

stories.title: Elon Musk hails Xi Jinping’s leadership and Chinese AI capabilities on state media

en.title: Elon Musk hails Xi Jinping's leadership and Chinese AI capabilities on state media
en.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk praised Chinese President Xi Jinping as a capable leader whose tenure has brought prosperity to China, in an interview with China's state broadcaster on Wednesday.

stories.title: Northern Metropolis data hub to start phased operations in mid-2027: CLP Power

en.title: Northern Metropolis data hub to start phased operations in mid-2027: CLP Power
en.summary: A supercomputing hub at Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis megadevelopment will begin phased operations in mid-2027, earlier than originally planned. CLP Power confirmed it has sufficient capacity to support energy demands from multiple data centres of similar scale over the next decade.

stories.title: 田昊：体操男团决赛有些紧张，但结果预料之中

en.title: Tian Hao: Men's Gymnastics Team Final Was Somewhat Tense, but Result Was as Expected
en.summary: China's men's gymnastics team won gold at the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games team final with a total score of 255.095 points, securing their third consecutive Asian Games title.

stories.title: Korean dating show featuring AI and human contestants sparks fascination in China

en.title: Korean dating show featuring AI and human contestants sparks fascination in China
en.summary: A South Korean dating reality show that explores romantic relationships between humans and AI has generated significant interest in China. The programme, launched by Seoul Broadcasting System in August, follows participants developing emotional connections with artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Hong Kong unveils gold, bond and liquidity plans to drive next phase of yuan adoption

en.title: Hong Kong unveils gold, bond and liquidity plans to drive next phase of yuan adoption
en.summary: Hong Kong's exchange operator plans to launch yuan-denominated gold futures in early 2025, while the city's central bank will introduce additional yuan products and platforms to support the currency's internationalization and digital development.

stories.title: Physical moves by online financial firms unlikely to pump up property market: analysts

en.title: Physical moves by online financial firms unlikely to pump up property market: analysts
en.summary: Digital financial firms in Hong Kong are opening physical locations to strengthen brand presence and compete for market share, though analysts expect limited impact on the city's retail property market.

stories.title: Chinese EV battery giant CATL starts trial production at Hungarian factory

en.title: Chinese EV battery giant CATL starts trial production at Hungarian factory
en.summary: CATL, the world's largest EV battery producer, has begun trial production at its €7.3 billion facility in Debrecen, Hungary, after obtaining all necessary regulatory approvals. The plant is expected to serve international automakers like BMW and Volkswagen.

stories.title: AI trade outlook brightens on falling oil and Meta’s Muse agent ahead of Xi-Trump meeting

en.title: AI trade outlook brightens on falling oil and Meta's Muse agent ahead of Xi-Trump meeting
en.summary: Technology stocks are gaining momentum due to declining oil prices, Meta's new AI tool launch, and expectations around the China-US leadership summit, with the Nasdaq-100 reaching record highs.

stories.title: Chinese maker of robot-vacuum sensors launches Hong Kong IPO, undeterred by US ban

en.title: Chinese maker of robot-vacuum sensors launches Hong Kong IPO, undeterred by US ban
en.summary: Shenzhen Camsense Technologies, which manufactures spatial sensors for robotic vacuum cleaners, is conducting a Hong Kong IPO seeking to raise approximately HK$680 million despite a recent US import ban on foreign-made vacuum robots. The company states that current exports and procurement remain unaffected, with disruption limited to new product development schedules.
